rows.text: The supplied fixture full_data_update_r14_run.py carries a UTF-8 BOM and one CRLF; the R15 fixture has no BOM and 295 CRLF. Both were staged byte-identically; the test reads them with utf-8-sig, so the BOM does not alter the parsed AST.

The gate is reachable only through the supplied plan/response surface. Both the plan revalidation inside assemble_responses and the input contract reject a numeric axis, so an int64 date column cannot silently pass the candidate.

The three legacy tests assert the opposite direction: the pinned legacy functions still return PASS while writing no date, writing 200 of 201 requested securities, or renaming an integer column to date. Reproduced as mechanism only.

The genuine preflight for this round ran the pinned operating entry describe path and returned ok=true, MUST_READ_PRECHECK=PASS, task_class=[CACHE], problems=[]; it is a read-only describe, no acquisition and no CURRENT switch.
Nothing in this round was integrated: the candidate gate sits outside both the production writer and the formal engine, and the live updater was not patched.
